command: claude CLI 2.1.285 print mode (claude -p --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort high --tools '' --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config '{"mcpServers":{}}' --no-session-persistence --system-prompt <porting system prompt>, prompt file on stdin, run from an empty directory)
notes:
Why the harness failed (outside this ticket):
- All three failing scenarios diverge in task 1, which is GT11 / GTTERM, not GTSHOW.
- At event 2, GTTERM's START records termid null where 'T001' is expected.
- The fix belongs in GTTERM's service, which this ticket may not edit (rule 6). Its START ... TERMID must pass the terminal id, e.g. task.termid() for TERMID(EIBTRMID), instead of null.
- Until that is fixed, GT12 is never scheduled on T001, so no GTSHOW task can be compared.
- The GTSHOW logic itself is unchanged from attempt 1. No divergence in a GT12 task was reported.

Defects of the original kept:
1. WS-COUNT is PIC 9 and ADD 1 has no SIZE ERROR. After 10 records it wraps to 0, so the 11th record is strung without its ',' separator. Fix: WS-COUNT PIC 9(4).
2. The loop ends on any response other than NORMAL, including LENGERR. A START FROM longer than 10 bytes is truncated, and neither it nor any record after it is shown. Fix: loop until ENDDATA and handle LENGERR records.
3. STRING has no ON OVERFLOW. A combined line longer than 40 bytes is cut silently. Fix: add ON OVERFLOW.

Assumption:
- The RETRIEVE data is decoded as the region's EBCDIC code page (IBM037), the same convention CicsTask documents for TS items.
- This must match the encoding GTTERM's port uses for START FROM bytes.
